※本段來源不足，待補考：卡伊沙小鼓音色明亮刺激，具有穿透力強的特徵。其音色質感乾: ※ Source insufficient for this section, pending verification: The caixa has a bright, exciting timbre with strong carrying power. The tone is dry and open, with a metallic sheen, and the range sits high. Striking the tight head sets it vibrating; the body, usually of wood, amplifies the sound waves and carries them. Compared with an ordinary snare drum, whose timbre is softer, the caixa sounds sharper and more exciting; compared with cymbals in the percussion section, its tone is warmer and thicker, though just as bright. In Brazilian music the caixa is common in samba rhythms, and working with the other percussion it marks out the rhythmic skeleton clearly. Its timbre can underline the strength of the beat while still blending well with the ensemble.
